title: South Korean government data: the country's exports grew 70.9% YoY in June to $102.25B, an all-time monthly high, anchored by a record $44.82B in chip shipments (Steven Borowiec/Nikkei Asia)
summary: Steven Borowiec / Nikkei Asia: South Korean government data: the country's exports grew 70.9% YoY in June to $102.25B, an all-time monthly high, anchored by a record $44.82B in chip shipments — SEOUL — South Korean exports in June surged past $100 billion for the first time, government figures showed Wednesday …
